Package index

Matching and duplicates

Drop-in replacements for base R functions. Inputs that are too small or have non-standard types fall back to base R.

Matching

par_match() `%par_in%` par_in()
Multithreaded match() and %in%
par_match_rows()
Multithreaded match() on rows
par_match_all() par_match_rows_all()
All matches, not just the first
par_find_interval()
Bin values by sorted breaks, in parallel

Duplicates and sets

par_duplicated() par_unique() par_any_duplicated()
Multithreaded duplicated() and unique()
par_union() par_intersect() par_setdiff()
Set operations, in parallel

Factors, dates, ranks, and sums

par_factor() par_table()
Make a factor, or count values, in parallel
par_as_date() par_as_posixct()
Parse dates and times, in parallel
par_rank()
Rank values, in parallel
par_rowsum()
Sum by group, in parallel
par_approx()
Interpolate linearly, in parallel

String operations

Not exact base R equivalents. Threads read the strings straight from R’s memory.

Regular expressions

Rust’s regex syntax, not R’s.

par_detect() par_count()
Detect regex matches, in parallel
par_extract() par_extract_all() par_locate() par_locate_all() par_replace() par_replace_all()
Extract or replace regex matches, in parallel

Dictionary lookup

Many literal terms at once, in one pass per string.

par_match_term() par_count_term() par_which_term() par_match_term_all()
Find which term each string contains, in parallel
par_replace_term()
Replace dictionary terms, in parallel
